in_sanskrit.name: भूपति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भूर्भुवस्स्गभः पतिः (bhūr bhuvas sgabhaḥ patiḥ) - The Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Atmosphere, and the Lord of all beings.

in_hindi.name: भूपती
in_hindi.meaning: राजा (rājā) - King, पृथ्वी (pṛthvī) - Earth - भूपति (bhūpati) - The King of the Earth.

in_tamil.name: பூபாதி
in_tamil.meaning: கொல்லாம் (kollām) - Land, பூமி (pūmi) - Earth - பூபாதி (pūpādi) - The Lord of the Land, the King of the Earth.

in_telugu.name: భూపతి
in_telugu.meaning: మృదేశ (mṛdēśa) - Kingdom, భూషేశ (bhūṣēśa) - Lord of the Earth - భూపతి (bhūpati) - The King of the Earth.

in_marathi.name: Bhoopati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoopati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhoo: Earth Patni: Lord, Master Bhoopati: One who rules over the Earth.

in_bengali.name: Bhoopati
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhoopati একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhoo: Earth Patni: Lord, Master Bhoopati: One who rules over the Earth.
